snippet.title: Danganronpa: Fandom's Calling - 2021 Trailer
snippet.description:
Thank you for watching!

Discord: https://discord.gg/RcRBrBa

FAQ and synopsis:

Synopsis

In a universe similar to ours, Danganronpa (The video game series by Spike Chunsoft) has a huge impact on the Japanese gaming fan base. So much so, that a hardcore fan of the games decided to open a real life Hope's Peak Academy. This person funded an elite school, where only 'Ultimates' - Students with exceptional talents and abilities -  would be recruited. Basing everything off of the game, even up to the architecture of the building. It seems unreal, but a replica of the despair full Hope's Peak was finally real. However, the founder of this school has ulterior motives. Why? Are they a disciple of Junko? Or are they so invested in the game that they take it too far? Just as 16 Ultimate Students (all fans of Danganronpa, of course) enter the Material Hope's Peak, they realize they have made an unfortunate mistake stepping foot into the establishment. A mechanical bear comes out of nowhere. To most people, this would be confusing. But if you know Danganronpa, it isn't just any bear...

"I mean... What did they expect? Idiots. You can't just expect an Academy based off a murderous school- No, a spiraling pit of despair filled school to not have consequences."

•

What is the gameplay like?
There are daily and deadly life segments, all of which are playable. You will be participating in FTEs, Investigations, and Class Trials. I will be trying to get as close as possible to the original.

When will the next part be released? Is it free?
Be sure to frequently check #game-releases for updates! Currently, the prologue has been released and I am working my hardest to get chapter 1 out there. There is no official release date as of yet. DRFC is and always will be free.

What engine do you use?
The prologue was created in RPG Maker VX Ace but Chapter 1 onward will be created using RPG Maker MV.

Can I make a let's play/live stream your game? What about fan videos?
You can make whatever you like! Just please credit me and link the game.

Can I edit the sprites as well as use them in RPs?
You can edit whatever you like and use my sprites for roleplaying, just please clearly credit me! I do not want people getting misguided.

Do you need help with production?
Not at the moment, but spots may open up in the future.

I saw some assets from SDRA2. What's that about?
In the prologue, there are two assets used that were created by LINUJ. These have already been replaced for chapter 1 and will not be used further. Programming will be different from SDRA2 from here on out.

Created by me (Zel)

Music by Summus:
https://twitter.com/Summusbackwards

@lazer-bunny
